name: Badge
description: An inline label used to communicate status, count, or categorical information at a glance. Supports five semantic variants and two sizes. A dot mode renders a compact indicator without text.

notes: When dot=true and no children are provided, aria-label is required to convey meaning to screen readers.
The dot element is aria-hidden when children are present alongside it.
Badge is a presentational element — do not rely on colour alone to convey information.

variant.description: Controls the colour palette of the badge. Maps to feedback colour tokens, except neutral which uses muted background.

size.description: Controls the padding and font size of the badge.

dot.description: When true, renders a small circular indicator instead of text content. Requires aria-label when children are absent.

placement.description: Positions the badge as an overlay at the specified corner of a parent element. The parent must have position: relative.

content.description: Content to display inside the badge. Alternative to children (Base Web pattern). When both content and children are provided, content takes precedence.

children.description: Label content displayed inside the badge.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

aria-label.description: Required when dot=true and no children are provided, to give screen readers a textual description.

variants.neutral: Default state. Uses muted background and default text. For generic labels with no semantic meaning.
variants.info: Informational state. Uses info feedback tokens. For supplementary context.
variants.success: Positive or complete state. Uses success feedback tokens.
variants.warning: Caution state. Uses warning feedback tokens. For items needing attention.
variants.danger: Error or critical state. Uses danger feedback tokens. For failures or blocking issues.

do: Use badge to communicate status inline with related content.
Provide aria-label when using dot=true without children.
Pair badge with adjacent text so colour is not the only information carrier.
dont: Do not use badge as a standalone interactive element.
Do not use badge to replace a full notification system.
Do not render dot=true without an aria-label and without children.
